title: kruzovic7/ai-data-extractor
why_read: A practical utility for extracting and consolidating chat histories from multiple AI coding assistants addresses a real annoyance for developers using several such tools.
analysis: This tool extracts conversation histories from a range of AI coding assistants including Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Aider, and Cline/Roo Code, presumably normalizing them into a common format for review, search, or archiving. This is a useful bit of developer tooling glue rather than a research breakthrough, solving the practical problem of chat logs being scattered across proprietary tool formats. Its value depends heavily on how many of these tools a given developer actually uses and whether the extraction is reliable across format changes.
